data.name: Omid
data.gender_notes: Omid is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Amin' meaning trust or hope. In Islamic tradition, Omid represents the belief in Allah's promise and the hope for His mercy and guidance. The name Omid carries the meaning “Hope” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Omid usually hope their child will grow to embody hope and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with hope and trust in Allah.
data.etymology: Omid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hope.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Omid total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
